topics.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim
topics.summary: Nvidia's board said on November 12, 2026 that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones the first board chair. The release gives no reason; press coverage ties the exit to a board investigation opened on November 8, 2026.

topics.title: Anthropic sets an IPO price range of $70 to $78 a share
topics.summary: An updated filing on November 10, 2026 shows Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each on Nasdaq, raising up to about $64.4 billion, with a concurrent $26 billion private placement to partners including Nvidia and Google.

topics.title: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, businesses and AI Ultra subscribers
topics.summary: On November 10, 2026 Google made Gemini 4 Carbon, first given to a small group of cybersecurity defenders two weeks earlier, available to developers, businesses, scientists and Google AI Ultra subscribers. Google positions it above Gemini 4 Argon for the hardest tasks.
